A simulated population of 150 inbred lines with 1,998 markers

Source: R/data.R
panel_genotypes.Rd

The genotypes behind the three rolling-panel trials panel_dense, panel_sparse and panel_misspecified. Three subpopulations of eight founders each; fifteen families of ten recombinant inbred lines, each family a biparental cross of two founders of one subpopulation, every line a mosaic of the two parental haplotypes with crossovers along each of ten chromosomes, homozygous apart from two per cent residual heterozygosity. The founder haplotypes carry subpopulation-specific allele frequencies and linkage disequilibrium along the chromosome. Markers with a minor allele frequency below 0.05 were removed. Everything is simulated; nothing comes from any real trial.

Usage

panel_genotypes

Format

A list:

markers

integer matrix of dosages (0, 1, 2) of the counted allele, 150 lines in rows, 1,998 markers in columns, with the line and marker names as dimnames.

map

data frame with the marker, its chromosome (1 to 10) and its position in centimorgans on a chromosome of 100 cM.

relationship

the relationship matrix of VanRaden (2008) computed from the markers and scaled to a mean diagonal of one, so that the genetic variance is the variance of a line's genetic value.

covariates

the first three principal components of the centred markers, with the line names as row names.

family

the family of each line, named by line.

subpopulation

the subpopulation of each line's founders, named by line.

Source

Simulated by data-raw/make_panels.R in the package sources.

References

VanRaden, P. M., 2008 Efficient methods to compute genomic predictions. Journal of Dairy Science 91: 4414-4423.

Examples

str(panel_genotypes$markers)
#>  int [1:150, 1:1998] 2 2 2 2 1 2 2 2 2 2 ...
#>  - attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   ..$ : chr [1:150] "L001" "L002" "L003" "L004" ...
#>   ..$ : chr [1:1998] "chr01_0001" "chr01_0002" "chr01_0003" "chr01_0004" ...
table(panel_genotypes$family, panel_genotypes$subpopulation)
#>      
#>       S1 S2 S3
#>   F01 10  0  0
#>   F02 10  0  0
#>   F03 10  0  0
#>   F04 10  0  0
#>   F05 10  0  0
#>   F06  0 10  0
#>   F07  0 10  0
#>   F08  0 10  0
#>   F09  0 10  0
#>   F10  0 10  0
#>   F11  0  0 10
#>   F12  0  0 10
#>   F13  0  0 10
#>   F14  0  0 10
#>   F15  0  0 10
